brief: JPM frames the tape's sideways/lower chop around three Wall of Worry variables: Fed, AI fears, and US/Iran energy. On Fed, consensus expects a 25bp hike with no forward guidance from Warsh; Treasury pricing implies ~53bp of hikes including today's meeting, and Jay Barry's five scenarios map guidance outcomes to SPX ranges from -1.75% (no hike) to +1% (25bp plus removing 2025 eases) to -2% (a hawkish 'crush inflation' surprise). Feroli sees hikes in both September and December with the dot plot rising to 3.25%. On AI, Anthropic CEO Amodei's comments drove the largest one-day move in JPM's Software-vs-Semis pair; JPM sees no imminent capex downturn, citing hyperscaler leverage falling despite 92% YoY debt growth and improving cloud AI margins as monetization evidence. On energy, crude above $100/bbl is a headwind, and JPM says WTI falling to the mid-$80s would boost stocks, while UK-Saudi cooperation against Houthi threats is a fresh escalation risk. Despite bullish fundamentals (above-trend GDP, >20% EPS growth), JPM stays Tactically Cautious/Neutral into the Fed meeting because of a new cycle-high 10Y yield and elevated bond volatility, not weak growth.
